about: Which free tool's footer points at which for-profit product (owner, 2026-11-24: free tools are lead magnets for the products people pay for). Chosen by hand: a feeder is listed only where its visitor is doing a smaller piece of the job the product does whole. The pitch is one plain line of what the product does, true of the page it links to today; no prices, no claims about a paid edition that is not on sale. Read by platform/pages/build.mjs (loadProductFunnels); checked by platform/pages/product-funnel.test.mjs. How to add one: README.md here, 'Funnels'.

sales-export-to-journal.pitch: drop any platform's sales or payout export and get a balanced month-split journal for Xero or QuickBooks

ai-bookkeeper.pitch: double-entry books from your bank and card CSVs, with an account suggested for every line and learned from your corrections

shift-roster-builder.pitch: a whole week's staff roster built from availability, hour limits and rest rules, covering every shift it can without overtime

league-schedule-generator.pitch: a full season's round-robin schedule with real dates, courts and time slots shared evenly, blackout dates and play-offs

changepoint-detector.pitch: paste a time series and see when its level or volatility changed, with PELT segmentation and Bayesian changepoint probabilities

xer-schedule-check.pitch: read a Primavera P6 XER export, recompute its critical path and run the DCMA 14-point assessment

ifc-quantity-takeoff.pitch: a bill of quantities straight from an IFC building model, every volume recomputed from its geometry

wall-framing-takeoff.pitch: type a house's walls, doors and windows and get the stud layout, cut list and cheapest lumber order

shed-designer.pitch: design a gable shed by dragging, then get drawings, a 3D view, a cut sheet and a priced shopping list

photo-editing.pitch: copy a card with checksums, cull blurred and duplicate frames, develop the raws and grade the shoot on your Mac

real-estate-agent-photo-app.pitch: check a listing's photos against MLS resolution, size, format and aspect-ratio rules before you deliver

quick-pick-survey.pitch: a pairwise survey: people pick one of two options and it infers a ranked order with confidence intervals

print-atelier.pitch: check an artwork file's DPI at the print size you want before you pay for a proof

clothing-design-studio.pitch: design a tee or hoodie, cost it from your manufacturer's own prices and export a tech pack and quote request
